text.text_excerpt: Damn are Beth Biundo cakes drop dead gorgeous. I was lucky enough to pick up my birthday gift from my boss here and tbh hadn't heard about this gourmet bakery until last month. Was able to promptly park my car with free street parking (SCORE) and quietly walked in. There are a few chairs and tables to enjoy your sweets on-site if one desires. I believe they might even serve coffee but forgot to verify for y'all. What really stood out to me though was the presentation of the cake and the seamless checkout process. It's an open bakery so it was pretty neat to be seeing them in action and it is a full blown operation! I was presented with my cake and the piping was mind-damn-blowing. It was ...

I've never had anything from Beth Biundo that wasn't mind-blowingly delicious and we can just go ahead and add her king cake pound cake to that list. Her bakery is so chic and I love the very open design where you can sometimes catch a glimpse of cookies being decorated or cakes being baked in the kitchen. I've had her sugar cookies, her pound cake, and her ice cream sandwiches and they've all been fantastic. She always has special treats for all the different holidays too so you can always count on her for themed desserts. I often see Beth there meeting with people and just enjoying her own space, which is why it feels so great to give back to her. I think this place has become my favori...

I have been a huge Beth Biundo fan since she was the pastry chef at Lilette. Everything she makes is absolutely delicious and beautifully presented. Her shop is a delight, as you can also pick up fun and unique greeting cards and gifts along with the scrumptious offerings. Her cupcakes are little works of art, and there isn't a better chocolate chip cookie in the city. She also makes amazing things like Nutella ice cream and pistachio ice cream sandwiches. During Mardi Gras, I love her sugar cookies decorated like miniature king cakes. I dare you to find anything cuter! And of course, I commissioned Beth to make my wedding cake.
